newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady in narrow trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady in narrow trade on Thursday with physical buying low but limited arrivals holding the market at previous level, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,280/1,320 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,305/1,368 rupees.

Sugar mill delivery however fell to 1,215/1,225 rupees per quintal from 1,220/1,230 rupees on increased offerings by mill owners amidst lower than expected outstation buying, one broker said. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
